claims.evidence: All 25 RAW entries in the PRIDE file list (projectAccessions contain PXD007193) and all 25 'Raw file' rows of summary.txt; each claimed once.

claims.location: source name, factor value[treatment], factor value[disease] rows 1-25
claims.value: 8 groups: CTR, CTR T, BTZ, BTZ T, TMZ 25, TMZ 50, BTZ TMZ25, BTZ TMZ50
claims.evidence: summary.txt 'Experiment' column maps each raw file to '<group> <cage><animal>' (e.g. 10_C6A1ny -> 'TMZ 50 C6A1'); animal code matches the file name in every row.

claims.value: temozolomide 25 mg/kg, temozolomide 50 mg/kg, bortezomib 0.5 mg/kg
claims.evidence: Paper Drugs section: 'mouse 25 mg/kg and 50 mg/kg TMZ doses are equivalent to human doses of 84 mg/m2 and 164 mg/m2 ... BTZ 0.5 mg/kg ... equivalent to 1.3 mg/m2'; Supplementary Methods lists the treatment groups with the same doses. MaxQuant labels 'TMZ 25/50' interpreted as these mouse doses.

claims.location: characteristics[treatment] rows of group CTR / CTR T
claims.evidence: Suppl. Fig. 1F legend: 'Ctrl -Tumour' and 'Ctrl +Tumour (vehicle)'; Fig. 5 legend: 'Control non-tumour-bearing mice were untreated'.

claims.value: glioblastoma (groups with T and all TMZ arms) / normal (CTR, BTZ)
claims.evidence: 'T' suffix in MaxQuant group names plus Suppl. Fig. 1F legend groups -T/+T (TMZ and BTZ+TMZ arms are +T). Inference from labels; MONDO:0018177 glioblastoma and PATO:0000461 normal confirmed in OLS.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; paper: NOD-SCID mice; MaxQuant FASTA Mouse_Reviewed.
PRIDE title/protocol 'Plasma samples'; Suppl. Fig. 1E 'proteins ... in the plasma of all animals'; UBERON:0001969.
Cell-free plasma.
Paper: spheroids implanted into 7-week-old mice; plasma sampled at sacrifice weeks later. Age of non-tumour mice not stated. Cohort-level inference.
Paper: 'severe combined immunodeficient (NOD-SCID) mice (C.B.-Igh-1b/lcrTac-Prkdc) (Janvier Labs)' for xenograft hosts; strain of non-tumour controls not stated.
Paper: 'male and female' mice and 'Both sexes were used'; no per-animal sex.

Instrument-ID block of all 25 raw files: model 'Orbitrap Elite', serial 04000B, software 2.7.0 SP1; method instrument 'Orbitrap Elite MS'. Contradicts paper/PRIDE protocol 'LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro' and PRIDE field 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos'; raw data preferred.
Method header: 'Nth Order Double Play', 'Scan Event 2 repeated for top 12 peaks', data dependent settings.

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer], comment[ms1 scan range]
claims.value: CID (MS:1000133); 35 NCE; radial ejection linear ion trap (MS:1000083); 300m/z-2000m/z
claims.evidence: Method header: 'FTMS + p norm o(300.0-2000.0)', 'ITMS + c norm Dep ... MS/MS', 'Activation Type: CID', 'Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0'.
Protocol: digestion with modified porcine trypsin (Promega V5111); MaxQuant search enzyme Trypsin/P, specific.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Acetyl Protein N-term variable; Oxidation M variable
claims.evidence: parameters.txt 'Fixed modifications: Carbamidomethyl (C)'; summary.txt 'Variable modifications: Acetyl (Protein N-term);Oxidation (M)'; PRIDE data processing protocol agrees.
parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.5 Da'; MS2 acquired in the ion trap.
Not recorded in the deposited MaxQuant txt files; protocol only says MaxQuant default settings.
PRIDE quantificationMethods: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification; MaxQuant LFQ.
One injection of 1 ug tryptic peptides per animal; one raw file per MaxQuant experiment; no fractionation described.

limitations: Group-to-treatment/tumour-status interpretation of MaxQuant labels relies on paper dose statements and Suppl. Fig. 1F legend; no deposited table spells out the regimens per file.
Xenograft line (P3 vs BG7) per plasma donor is not stated; not annotated.
Per-animal sex and age unavailable; developmental stage is cohort-level inference for tumour-bearing mice only.
Strain of non-tumour-bearing control mice not stated explicitly.
Precursor mass tolerance not recorded in deposited search files.
PRIDE/paper MaxQuant version 1.5.2.8 conflicts with deposited parameters.txt version 1.5.1.2.
Suppl. Fig. 1E heat map shows 19 animals in 6 groups while the deposit has 25 runs in 8 groups; all 25 deposited runs annotated per the MaxQuant table.
Treatment schedules and sampling times are not encoded.
